card.name: Spine and muscle-tightness texts, citation commas
card.fires_on: Punctuation and small linking words inside spine-deformity (Scheuermann's, kyphosis) and muscle tight/weak passages, especially the comma between author names in reference lists.

modes.label: Author-list commas
modes.description: Comma between author names in a spine-disease reference citation.
modes.example: Spiegel DA, Hosalkar HS<<,>> Dormans JP. The spine. In

modes.label: Muscle tight/weak wording
modes.description: Linking words or brackets in text about muscles locked long or short.
modes.example: which opposing muscles<< are>> locked short (tight).

modes.label: Spinal curvature causes
modes.description: The word 'by' after a curvature or kyphosis cause.
modes.example: Kyphosis caused<< by>> infection or tumor needs to be treated more
